task: Track 2 — example test data (not_controlled) for POST /advise classification
notes: Precedence: KMV Annex 1 (war materiel list, KM 1-22) always prevails. An item that is war materiel is NOT a specific military good under GKV Annex 3.
KM numbers mirror ML numbers but the KM list is a subset: KM 14, 15, 18 and 22 contain no entries, so e.g. ML15 (night vision / thermal) items stay `specific_military` under GKV Annex 3.
KM 1 covers only hand and pistol firearms of any calibre (Hand- und Faustfeuerwaffen); other weapons (rifles, machine guns, mortars, cannons) are KM 2.
Each entry's `request` is a ready-to-send /advise payload (item block only).
`expected` is the ground truth for scoring: controlled flag, regime, control list entries.
Entries cite GKV Annex 2 (dual-use list), e.g. '3A001.a.5.a' is shorthand for the specific paragraph.
specifications are deliberately free-form (varied keys/units), matching the API contract.
Several not-controlled items sit exactly on the threshold boundary (thresholds are strict '>' unless stated otherwise).

item.description: 12-bit ADC IC for industrial condition monitoring

expected.note: 12 bit requires > 400 MSPS under 3A001.a.5.a; 390 MSPS is below

item.description: 14-bit ADC IC for audio measurement

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.5.a requires sampling rate > 250 MSPS; exactly 250 does not exceed it

item.description: 10-bit ADC IC for process control

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.5.a requires > 600 MSPS at 10 bit; exactly 600 does not exceed it

item.description: 16-bit Sigma-Delta ADC IC for power quality analyzers

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.5.a requires > 65 MSPS at 16 bit; exactly 65 does not exceed it

item.description: 8-bit flash ADC IC for digital oscilloscope entry model

expected.note: 8 bit requires > 1.3 GSPS under 3A001.a.5.a; 1.2 GSPS is below

item.description: ADC IC with on-chip FIFO for sensor interface

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.14 requires > 400 MSPS at 14 bit (stores digitized data); exactly 400 does not exceed it

item.description: ADC IC with embedded processor for edge analytics

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.14 requires > 180 MSPS at 16 bit; exactly 180 does not exceed it

item.description: bench-top oscilloscope digitizer, entry-level

expected.note: 3A002.h uses the 3A001.a.14 thresholds for 12 bit equipment (> 1.0 GSPS); 900 MSa/s is below

item.description: transient recorder, 14-bit

expected.note: boundary: 3A002.h / 3A001.a.14 requires > 400 MSPS at 14 bit; exactly 400 does not exceed it

item.description: 10-bit DAC IC for audio test equipment

expected.note: 3A001.a.5.b requires AUR > 3500 MSPS at 10 bit; 3000 MSPS is below

item.description: 12-bit DAC IC for ultrasonic transducer drive

expected.note: AUR 2000 MSPS is in the (1250, 3500] band but neither extra condition is met: settling 12 ns >= 9 ns and SFDR 60 dBc <= 68 dBc

item.description: 12-bit video DAC IC for display drivers

expected.note: AUR 1000 MSPS is below 1250 MSPS for 12-bit DACs under 3A001.a.5.b

item.description: 14-bit DAC IC for medical ultrasound

expected.note: boundary: 3A001.a.5.b requires AUR > 3500 MSPS for >=12 bit, or (1250, 3500] with settling < 9 ns or SFDR > 68 dBc; exactly 3500 MSPS with settling 15 ns and SFDR 62 dBc meets none

item.description: DDS IC for consumer RF tuning applications

expected.note: 3A001.a.13 requires DAC clock >= 3.5 GHz at 10 bit; 3.0 GHz is below

item.description: DDS IC for test signal generation

expected.note: 3A001.a.13 requires DAC clock >= 1.25 GHz for >= 12 bit; 1.2 GHz is below

item.description: electronic streak camera for plasma diagnostics

expected.note: 6A003.a requires time resolution < 50 ns and 6A203 requires <= 50 ns for electronic streak cameras; 80 ns is above both

item.description: high-speed framing camera for slow-motion research

expected.note: 6A003.a requires > 1,000,000 frames/s and 6A203 requires > 225,000 frames/s; 200,000 frames/s is below both

item.description: gated ICCD camera for laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy

expected.note: 6A203 requires fast image gating time <= 50 ns for semiconductor/electron-tube cameras; 60 ns is above

item.description: monochrome CMOS industrial camera for barcode reading

expected.note: 6A003.b requires > 4x10^6 active pixels for monochrome semiconductor cameras; 3.2 M is below

item.description: uncooled thermal imaging module for predictive maintenance

expected.note: 327,680 active pixels is far below the 6A003.b pixel thresholds, and the uncooled microbolometer array is not an FPA covered by 6A002.a.3
